agents.name: Recon Agent
agents.description: Extracts byte-accurate AST slices enclosing critical security sinks (CWE-78, CWE-89, CWE-22).

agents.name: Prover Agent
agents.description: Evaluates SMT-LIB2 queries to mathematically prove vulnerability reachability (SAT) and post-patch soundness (UNSAT).

agents.name: Tester Agent
agents.description: Synthesizes transient unit tests that deterministically reproduce failure on unpatched targets.

agents.name: Patcher Agent
agents.description: Synthesizes minimal surgical git diffs and passes through AST Anti-Cheat gate (0 empty catches, 100% exports intact).

agents.name: Auditor Agent
agents.description: Verifies Ed25519 signatures and SHA-256 hash chaining in the node:sqlite WAL audit ledger.
